body.p: AMENDMENTS TO THE CLAIMSThis listing of the claims will replace all prior versions and listings of the claims in the application:

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A system comprising:a wireless transmit and receive circuit comprising one or more transmit antenna elements configured to transmit wireless signals and one or more receive antenna elements, at least two transmit-receive antenna element pairs configured to receive wireless reflections of the transmitted wireless signals derived from a heart; and
a cardiac beamformer comprising:
a heart signal extractor configured to receive channel signals from the receive antenna elements and in response extract a heart signal using a convolutional neural network (CNN);
a phase extractor configured to receive the channel signals and in response generate projection signals by isolating groups of the channel signals into different buckets; and
an extractor configured to identify a spatial beam for analyzing wireless reflections based on the extracted heart signal and the generated projection signals extract phase information from time-domain signals output from the at least two transmit-receive antenna element pairs, the phase information corresponding to one or more regions in a surrounding environment, and
a heart signal extractor comprising a convolutional neural network (CNN) configured to receive signals from the at least two transmit-receive antenna element pairs and in response extract an estimated heart signal.
2. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1,further comprising a wireless-to- seismocardiogram translator configured to implement amachine-learning model to translate information extracted from the spatial beam to a seismocardiogramwherein the heart signal extractor includes:
an extractor configured to identify a spatial beam based on the extracted phase information and the estimated heart signal and to extract time-series phase information of a signal received via the identified spatial beam.
3. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1,further comprising an automatic labeler configured to label features of a seismocardiogram wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit comprises one transmit antenna element and a plurality of receive antenna elements.
4. (Currently Amended) The system of claim [[1]]_3, wherein the features comprise at least two features within a heart beat in the seismocardiogram wireless transmit and receive circuit comprises a plurality of transmit antenna elements and one receive antenna element.
5. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to transmit and receive frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signals.
6. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein:
the wireless transmit and receive circuit comprises a one-dimensional (1D) array of antenna elements, and
the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to transmit and receive frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signals.
7. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein:the wireless transmit and receive circuit comprises a two-dimensional (2D) array of antenna elements, and
the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to transmit and receive frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) signals.
8. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein:the heart signal extractor is configured to receive phase data from [[the]] at least two transmit-receive antenna element pairs, and
the CNN is configured to extract the estimated heart signal based on at least the phase data.
9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 1, wherein:the heart signal extractor is configured to receive a filtered time series of phase data from [[the]] at least two transmit-receive antenna element pairs, and
the CNN is configured to extract the estimated heart signal based on at least the filtered time series of phase data.
10. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to operate in the radio frequency (RF) range.
11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim [[11]]_1, wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to operate in the millimeter wave (MMW) frequency range.
12. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to operate in the acoustic frequency range.
13. (Original) The system of claim 1, wherein the wireless transmit and receive circuit is configured to operate in the ultrasonic frequency range.
14. (Currently Amended) A systemwireless-to-seismocardiogram translator, comprising:a receiver configured to receive wireless signals derived from a heart; and
at least one processor configured to:implement amachine-learning model to translate the wireless signals to a seismocardiogram based on coefficients determined using a first machine learning model; and
detect and label at least two features in at least one heart beat in the seismocardiogram using a second, different, machine learning model.
15. (Currently Amended) The translator system of claim 14, wherein the receiver is configured to receive the wireless signals from a beamformer.
16. (Currently Amended) The translator system of claim 14, wherein at least one of the first machine-learning machine learning model or the second machine learning model comprises a CNN-based model.
17. (Currently Amended) The translator system of claim 14, wherein the machine-learning model comprises an RNN-based model at least two features comprises five features, the five features corresponding to an aortic valve opening (AO), aortic valve closing (AC), mitral valve opening (MO), mitral valve closing (MC), and isovolumetric contracting (IM).
18. (Currently Amended) The translator system of claim 14, wherein the receiver is configured to receive radio frequency signals.
19. (Currently Amended) The system translator of claim 14, wherein the receiver is configured to receive acoustic signals.
20. (Currently Amended) The system translator of claim 14, wherein the receiver is configured to receive ultrasonic frequency signals.
